edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner address.
Constructor derives the initial owner from msg.sender via _msgSender.
Constructor requires release end time to be after block.timestamp.
releasedBalance branches on block.timestamp against release times.
terminate computes the new release end time from block.timestamp.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY for time rounding and end time.
Constructor stores the token address into _token.
Constructor stores the beneficiary into _beneficiary.
Constructor stores the rounded start time into _releaseStartTime.
Constructor computes and stores _releaseEndTime.
Constructor stores the total benefit into _totalBenefit.
Constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero.
Constructor initializes _isTerminated to false.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance reads _totalBenefit to compute proportional amount.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance.
withdraw uses releasedBalance to determine available amount.
withdraw reads and increments _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw sends tokens to the _beneficiary address.
withdraw interacts with the stored _token contract.
terminate is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
terminate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with releasedBalance.
terminate recomputes and stores _releaseEndTime.
terminate sets the termination flag to true.
terminate transfers remaining tokens to the owner address.
terminate queries balance of and transfers the stored _token.
_setOwner updates the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads the owner via owner() which returns _owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the new address.
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner with the zero address.
Constructor calls _setOwner to assign initial ownership.
withdraw performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer to the beneficiary.
terminate performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer to the owner.
releasedBalance contains day division and proportional multiplication.
terminate performs subtraction and modulo timestamp arithmetic.
withdraw accumulates _withdrawedBalance by the computed amount.
token_ parameter is assigned to _token in the constructor.
beneficiary_ parameter is assigned to _beneficiary in the constructor.
releaseStartTime_ parameter flows into release start/end computation.
daysOfTimelock_ parameter flows into release end time computation.
totalBenefit_ parameter is assigned to _totalBenefit.
newOwner parameter is forwarded from transferOwnership to _setOwner.
newOwner parameter is used to update _owner in _setOwner.
passedDays local is computed and used in releasedBalance.
totalDays local is computed and used in releasedBalance.
amount local is computed and transferred in withdraw.
amountToWithdraw local is computed and transferred in terminate.
oldOwner local captures the previous owner in _setOwner.
passedDays feeds the proportional benefit multiplication.
totalDays is the denominator of the proportional benefit division.
amount is added to _withdrawedBalance.
amountToWithdraw results from terminate subtraction arithmetic.
releasedBalance arithmetic depends on block.timestamp.
terminate arithmetic depends on block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: token_ constructor parameter is directly assigned to the _token state variable inside the constructor.
beneficiary_ constructor parameter is directly assigned to the _beneficiary state variable inside the constructor.
releaseStartTime_ constructor parameter directly drives the release schedule stored by the constructor.
daysOfTimelock_ constructor parameter directly drives the release end time computed by the constructor.
totalBenefit_ constructor parameter is directly assigned to the _totalBenefit state variable.
newOwner parameter is directly passed to _setOwner from transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is directly used in _setOwner to update _owner.
passedDays is a local computed and consumed only inside releasedBalance.
totalDays is a local computed and consumed only inside releasedBalance.
amount is a local computed and transferred only inside withdraw.
amountToWithdraw is a local computed and transferred only inside terminate.
oldOwner is a local used only inside _setOwner to capture the previous owner.
